notes.title: 63 Days is OUT NOW! 🎉
notes.content:
We've just dropped our newest [b]real-time tactics[/b] game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/][b]63 Days[/b][/url], and we’re pretty excited about it! 🎊
We’ve tried to level up from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101790/War_Mongrels/][b]War Mongrels[/b][/url] [i](which had its bumps at launch, let’s be real)[/i]. Not every battle you fight is a glorious victory and [b]63 Days[/b] was made very much with that in mind. We think we’ve done a much better job this time, but hey, you tell us how we did – [b]we’re really proud of this one[/b]. ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/

In short, [b]63 Days[/b] is a universal story of brotherhood, youthful passion and immense bravery against overwhelming odds. It follows everyday young people, whose lives got flipped upside down by [b]World War II[/b]. It takes you through their valiant effort to free the [b]Polish capital of Warsaw[/b] and beat back the German occupation over the titular [b]sixty-three days of the doomed uprising[/b], before it met its tragic end. As in [b]War Mongrels[/b], you use [b]stealth[/b], [b]teamwork[/b] and sometimes go all out [b]guns blazing[/b], depending on your playstyle and the optimal tactics in each situation. ːISD_Skullː

[previewyoutube=q1kUUxtYdoI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you’re curious but not ready to commit, no worries – you can grab the [b]63 Days[/b] [b]demo[/b] and give it a spin! Or if you buy it and it’s not your vibe, you can always refund [i](though we really hope you stick around so we can make another game after this one!)[/i]. ːsteammockingː



[i]Big thanks for reading and checking out [b]63 Days[/b]. We appreciate you so much! Hugs and kisses! 🖤[/i]

notes.title: 63 Days || WARSAW, 1944 & COMBAT MODE
notes.content: [previewyoutube=L-FqiMjbLNA;full][/previewyoutube]The Polish capital, [b]Warsaw[/b], was thriving prior to [b]WWII[/b]. Years of occupation took an immense toll, leaving the city almost entirely razed to the ground by the German army... ⚰️[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=W7_A2fa_h6A;full][/previewyoutube]Sometimes, when you're too tired to think, it feels like all you have is a hammer, and suddenly everything looks like a nail. notes.title: DESTRUCTIVE CREATIONS IS 10 YEARS OLD! 🥳
notes.content:
[h3]As part of our celebrations, we've chronicled the [b]DC history[/b] and showcased [b]new development[/b] and [b]publishing[/b] projects currently in the works ⤵️[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Mu8kJrtffGc;full][/previewyoutube]It might not be as fun as watching a cat fail compilation or your wedding video, featuring your favorite drunk uncle, but it’s light and fun whether you’re a DC fan, a DC hater [i](cheers to you!)[/i] or yet indifferent, but curious! 🎉🎉🎉
[hr][/hr][h3]Starting today, you can also try the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] of our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/][b]63 DAYS[/b][/url] title! 😎[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/ Coming of age as a part of the first generation born free, WWII stripped me of my family, home, and future. Now I'm left with only one choice: to get my revenge and independence, or die trying. The odds are against us: will our tactics, stealth and teamwork be enough?
